accuracyStatus: Street-network and satellite spot checks passed; facade-level accuracy has not been measured.
axisConvention: Browser positions use Rhino (X, Z, -Y). Near this fit, +X is east and -Z is north.
formula: EN = scale * R(angleDeg) * [modelX, zSign * modelZ] + [translationEast, translationNorth]

validation.method: OSM street samples against CAD block occupancy; entire OSM ways held out by id modulo 5
validation.warning: Block penetration is a street-consistency proxy, not a building-position or photo-reprojection error.

supersedes.reason: The prior transform omitted the north/south reflection required by the browser coordinate frame.
